Magnusson hex key set offers comprehensive fastener access, with 30 pieces covering metric and imperial measurement standards for professional and domestic use. Constructed from chrome vanadium steel. the hex keys offer exceptional durability and rust resistance. Contains 15 imperial keys with long arms and 15 metric keys with short arms. Supplied in a storage case to keep the set organised and accessible, eliminating time wasted searching for the correct size.
